98022460.s: Red Sea Museum in Jeddah is one of the most prominent cultural and tourist landmarks in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Red Sea Museum in Jeddah is one of the most prominent cultural and tourist landmarks in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The museum opened in 2021 as an initiative aimed at raising environmental and cultural awareness in the region, especially regarding marine life and biodiversity in the Red Sea. The museum covers a large area and has a variety of art and interactive exhibitions that present the history of the Red Sea, as well as modern applications of marine science. The museum focuses on environmental awareness activities through educational programs aimed at visitors of all ages. The museum is also a platform for local and international artists, hosting art exhibitions with works that express the beauty of marine nature and reflect the challenges facing the environment. The museum also contributes to developing cultural tourism in Jeddah and strengthens its position as a global tourist destination. The Red Sea Museum is distinguished by its unique architectural design that imitates the shapes of sea waves, making it a symbol of contemporary art and the spirit of the Red Sea. A range of events and activities is available to visitors, strengthening their connection with the world of the seas and oceans.
